notes.title: V1.4 Massive Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865610/4ae4454e7924f776986ae2177e4362fc4e7c84c2.png[/img]
New Features:
1. New Spaceship gallery:
   Spaceship dynamic display.
   Spaceship kills statistics.
   Background information on each spaceship.
2. New background information on the character gallery.
3. Add vertical sync to the image settings.
4. Add a recovery mechanism for energy depletion.
5. Add dynamic background effects in levels.

Optimization:
1. All character illustrations have been optimized and redrawn.
2. To address the issue of players forgetting to collect buffs before completing a level, the exit doors will be adjusted to require a three-choice selection before proceeding to the next level.
3. Optimization of the beginner tutorial.
4. UI interface enhancements, including button and menu border adjustments.
5. Resetting the image on the main menu.
6. Fixed the normal mode image bug.
7. Optimized the achievement gallery.
8. Optimized the button interactions.
9. Enhanced Japanese translation.
10. Update of Credits List

Bug fixes:
1. Fix the malfunctioning of the mine core.
2. Fix the occurrence probability issue with special structures.
3. Fix the interaction failure of the controller on the settlement page.
4. Fix the incorrect colors of the mines.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865610/d9559332e64b52cc93a1c79b1657f97ce9477f13.png[/img]

notes.title: V1.3 Major update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865610/2b0e99a06ebe2139a2500f03a63724ed81b38e4e.png[/img]
1. The number of story mode levels has been reduced, Saturn has been reduced to 7 levels, Jupiter has been reduced to 7 levels, Black Hole has been reduced to 10 levels, and Earth has been reduced to 7 levels
2. Adjusted the enemy waves and numbers to optimize the rhythm and experience
3. The difficulty parameter has been adjusted to increase the difficulty through the levels uniformly.
4. The difficulty of the three-color cat difficulty mode has been reduced again: the enemy's health has been reduced to 30%, and it cannot grow with the level, and some initial buffs are provided to the players
5. The basic values of some buffs have been modified, and the active buffs have been enhanced
6. The content of reinforcement has been increased: basic energy recovery, pickup range
7. Improved UI
8. Major update: Endless battle mode(Early adopter version)
9. Minor repair: three-choice collision adjustment is more accurate

notes.notes:
